title: Solar System Exploration
description: Planetary science, orbital mechanics, and outer boundary regions of the Solar System.

cards.title: Mercury's 3:2 Spin-Orbit Resonance
cards.summary: Mercury rotates exactly three times on its axis for every two revolutions around the Sun due to high orbital eccentricity and solar tidal locking.
cards.mnemonic: Three spins for two orbits: 3 days in 2 years under the intense solar gravitational grip.
acceptedAnswers: Mercury rotates three times on its axis for every two orbits around the Sun due to tidal forces and its eccentric orbit.
A 3:2 spin-orbit resonance where one solar day lasts two Mercury years.
cards.hint: 3 rotations for every 2 orbital revolutions around the Sun, resulting from tidal forces in an eccentric orbit.

cards.title: Jupiter's Magnetosphere & Great Red Spot
cards.summary: Jupiter possesses the largest planetary magnetic field powered by metallic hydrogen convection, harboring the Great Red Spot anticyclonic storm.
cards.mnemonic: Metallic hydrogen dynamo drives a magnetic shield millions of km wide holding a 300-year anticyclone.
acceptedAnswers: Jupiter's massive magnetic field is generated by liquid metallic hydrogen, shielding radiation belts and the giant Great Red Spot anticyclone.
The strongest planetary magnetosphere in the solar system, housing the persistent Great Red Spot high-pressure storm.
cards.hint: Convection in liquid metallic hydrogen creates a giant magnetosphere enclosing the anticyclonic Great Red Spot.

cards.title: Kuiper Belt vs Oort Cloud
cards.summary: The Kuiper Belt is a disk-shaped region of icy bodies (30-55 AU) home to Pluto; the Oort Cloud is a distant spherical shell (2,000-100,000 AU) of long-period comets.
cards.mnemonic: Kuiper is a flat disk just beyond Neptune; Oort is a vast spherical bubble wrapping the outer boundary.
acceptedAnswers: The Kuiper Belt is a planar icy belt from 30 to 50 AU, whereas the Oort Cloud is a vast spherical shell extending up to 100,000 AU.
Kuiper Belt is a donut disk of icy dwarf planets beyond Neptune; Oort Cloud is the spherical reservoir of long-period comets.
cards.hint: Disk beyond Neptune (Kuiper, ~30-55 AU) vs distant spherical shell (Oort, up to 100,000 AU).

cards.title: Olympus Mons & Tharsis Volcanism
cards.summary: The largest shield volcano in the solar system on Mars, standing ~22 km high, formed because Mars lacks mobile tectonic plates over stationary mantle hotspots.
cards.mnemonic: Three times Everest high: no shifting tectonic plates meant centuries of lava built one colossal shield.
acceptedAnswers: A 22-kilometer high shield volcano on Mars formed because stationary crust remained over a volcanic hotspot without tectonic plate movement.
The largest volcano in the solar system, towering 22 km above Martian plains due to lack of plate tectonics.
cards.hint: Martian shield volcano 2.5 times Mount Everest, formed because Mars lacks moving tectonic plates.

cards.title: The Heliopause & Interstellar Space
cards.summary: The boundary where solar wind pressure balances interstellar medium pressure, marking the true outer border of the heliosphere crossed by Voyager 1 and 2.
cards.mnemonic: Where solar wind stops and the galaxy begins: Voyager crossed the cosmic windbreak into interstellar space.
acceptedAnswers: The boundary where the solar wind pressure balances the interstellar medium, crossed by Voyager 1 and 2 entering interstellar space.
The outer boundary of the heliosphere where solar wind drops and interstellar cosmic rays surge.
cards.hint: Boundary where the sun's solar wind is arrested by the interstellar medium, crossed by Voyager 1 at ~121 AU.
